description: This Java class 'Cache' manages entity caching, including storing, retrieving, and removing cached entity data, with support for different cache types and cache invalidation based on entity properties.

classes.name: Cache
classes.description: A cache management class for entity data, supporting cache operations such as get, put, remove, and clear, with cache invalidation based on entity properties.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes cache entries by entity name or specific entity or primary key.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cached entity data by primary key or condition.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores entity data into cache, with support for cache invalidation based on entity properties.
